text: Childminder here, I have an 8 year old girl staying overnight as her parents are stuck abroad till tomorow afternoon. She's been running a temprature since this afternoon. I gave her calpol around 6 and then ibuprofen a bit later on (written all the times down for the parents). Honestly when the medicine is working shes completely herself, she's been playing with lego, drinking squash fine and chatting non stop to me about her school play. It's only when it starts to wear off that she gets hot again I think. The parents have given permission for me to give medicine and they say she's healthy normally. What I want to know is simple, can I carry on alternating the two overnight and see how she is in the morning, or does a temp that keeps coming back mean I need to get her seen tonight? Not sure if I'm overthinking it but I'd rather have a straight answer than guess. thanks
